purpose: Teach: 行お/コンパイラ/スタック/アクセシビリティ/ラーニング/ウィークリー/インスピレーション/もうける

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 提案を実行に移し行おうとしてる段階ね
lines.en: We're at the stage of moving the proposal into action.
lines.style: Crisp and assured. Slight forward lean in the phrasing. Conversational but directive—she's thinking aloud while setting the direction. Light emphasis on 'moving into'.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。コンパイラの更新を進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll push the compiler update forward.
lines.style: Attentive and ready. Quick, clean agreement. Professional warmth—he's listening and committed. No hesitation in the cadence.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 倉庫のスタック構造を見直しましょう
lines.en: Let's review the warehouse stack structure.
lines.style: Straightforward instruction. Clear and steady. She's not asking permission, but inviting him to think alongside her. Matter-of-fact tempo.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。サイトのアクセシビリティ評価を依頼します
lines.en: Yes. I'll request the site accessibility evaluation.
lines.style: Prompt confirmation. He's tracking the priorities and reporting back. Efficient but not rushed. Light upward lift on 'accessibility'—showing he's engaged.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: Eラーニングコンテンツを充実させましょう
lines.en: Let's build out the e-learning content.
lines.style: Collaborative direction. Slightly warmer than the last instruction—she's opening space for him to contribute. Steady, encouraging pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ウィークリーミーティングを定例化します
lines.en: Yes. I'll establish the weekly meetings as standard practice.
lines.style: Reliable and thorough. He's thinking ahead, naming what this commitment means. Professional, steady. Slight pause before 'standard'—showing he's considering the weight of it.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様にインスピレーションを与える展示にしましょう
lines.en: Let's make the display something that inspires our customers.
lines.style: Engaged and purposeful. She's reaching for something beyond routine—there's quiet ambition here. Warm but focused. Slight emphasis on 'inspire'.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地道にもうける経営を続けます
lines.en: Yes. I'll keep building steady, sustainable profit.
lines.style: Resolute close. He's affirming the philosophy underneath the tasks. Slow, measured delivery. The weight of sustained effort in his tone—not a quick win, but enduring.
